description:
The Google keywords a competitor ranks for that the site doesn't, and those where it outranks the site, ranked by opportunity.

Billing: 25¢ per run; the same inputs within 24h are free from cache. Not billed on a rejected site / competitor_domain or when no keywords come back.

When to call: 'what does <competitor> rank for that we don't'. AI-answer gaps: mine_competitor_prompts.

Returns { rows: [{keyword, search_volume, cpc_cents, competition (Ads 0–1), kd (0–100), intent, competitor_position, user_position, competitor_url, user_url, gap_kind: they_rank_we_dont|they_outrank_us|co_ranked, relevance, opportunity, tags?}], dropped, max_competitor_position, cache_hit, charged_cents }. Order: on-topic first, real gaps first, then opportunity = volume × position weight × relevance (0–1, overlap with the site's questions and keywords). tags: off_topic, other_brand / brand_review (half weight), comparison. Brand searches are dropped unless include_brand_queries. Not on the site's list: competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains.

competitor_domain.description: A competitor on the site's competitor_domains list (list_sites).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

include_brand_queries.description: true: keep the competitor's own brand searches. Default false.

language_code.description: Default: the location's language (en for US/UK/CA/AU, de for DE, fr for FR…).

limit.description: Max keywords per intersection mode, 10–100. Default 100.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (US). 2826 UK, 2124 CA, 2036 AU, 2276 DE, 2250 FR.

max_competitor_position.description: Only keywords the competitor ranks in the top N for. Default 20.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

name: find_content_gap
title: Find Google-search keywords a competitor ranks for that this site doesn't
